locations.title: Locations
locations.description: The places where you attend appointments. Choose a location on each block of hours in Booking schedules; the store shows the times by location.

settings.title: We can attend in more than one location at the same time
settings.onHelp: ON: several people or offices attend at the same time, so different locations can have the same hours. Each location has its own places.
settings.offHelp: OFF (recommended for one person): you are in one location at a time, so the same hours can not be in two different locations.
settings.savedOn: Saved: several locations can have the same hours.
settings.savedOff: Saved: one location at a time.
settings.offRefused: It can not be turned off yet: these hours are in two locations at the same time. Change them in Booking schedules first.
settings.saveError: The setting could not be saved.
settings.enabledOnHelp: ON: choose a location on each block of hours in Booking schedules (or let the customer choose). The store, the forms and the emails show the location.
settings.enabledOffHelp: OFF: AlephK works without locations. The store, the schedules, the forms and the emails show no location. You can prepare your locations here and turn this on when you are ready.
settings.enabledOn: Saved: AlephK now uses your locations.
settings.enabledOff: Saved: locations are hidden everywhere. Your locations are kept.
settings.enableRefused: Locations can not be turned on yet: these hours are in two locations at the same time. Change them in Booking schedules first, or turn on "We can attend in more than one location at the same time".
settings.needsEnabled: Available when "We use locations" is on.

overlap.title: Hours in two locations at the same time

list.title: Your locations
list.emptyHelp: With only one place you do not need locations. Add them when you attend in two or more places (for example Heredia and San Pedro).

map.help: Customers get an "Open in Maps" link. Without a point the link uses the address.

map.gpsDenied: The location permission was denied. Allow it in the browser, or paste a Google Maps link.
map.gpsFailed: Your location could not be read. Try again or paste a Google Maps link.
map.noGps: This browser cannot give your location. Paste a Google Maps link instead.
map.insecure: The browser gives your location only on secure pages (https) or on localhost. Paste a Google Maps link instead.
map.linkDone: Point read from the link. Check it with "Open in Maps" and save.
map.linkInvalid: No map point was found in that text. In Google Maps open the place and copy the address bar link (it has @latitude,longitude).
map.shortLink: Short links (maps.app.goo.gl) do not include the point. Open the link, then copy the long link from the address bar and paste it here.
map.none: No point and no address yet: customers get no map link.
